shots.content: Inside a meeting room, a rectangular conference table stands between a presentation screen and a glass door, with windows along one side; a clear walkway runs opposite the window. There is one empty place. A woman in a purple shirt sits at the door-side window seat and proposes spending the holiday at a quiet country retreat, while a man in a green shirt sits at the screen-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the glass door end, looking along the conference table toward the presentation screen, with both window-side seats and the screen-end seat and the presentation screen in frame.

shots.content: A woman in a red shirt enters and sits in the empty place. She proposes taking a sea trip instead to the woman in a purple shirt.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the walkway side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in a purple shirt argues that a boat journey would be exhausting rather than restful.
shots.viewpoint: Close-up from the walkway side, centered on the person at the door-side window seat.

shots.content: The woman in a purple shirt asks to reconsider the quiet retreat plan.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot of the conference table.
